name: Extra Hail of Arrows (Mythic)
body:
Your arrows are a shower and a cataclysm for your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Extra Hail of Arrows, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use hail of arrows. This stacks with the uses of hail of arrows per day gained through the nonmythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Extra Hail of Arrows, this feat may be selected only once.
